name: ultralytics-yolo
summary: Object-detection and vision inference stack for detection, tracking, segmentation, and related computer-vision workflows.
why_it_matters: Ultralytics YOLO preserves practical detection capability knowledge, but there is no current validated scenario that justifies maintaining it as an active resource.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs object detection or tracking.
Operators want local vision inference in media or robotics workflows.
The workflow depends on structured detections rather than generic image labeling.

platform_support.notes: Inference can run across platforms, but GPU acceleration, model packaging, and throughput differ substantially by environment.

prerequisites: Model selection and artifact storage plan
Defined output schema and downstream consumer workflow
implementation_notes: Promotion should validate a concrete detection workflow with representative inputs.
Keep model lifecycle explicit and version-pinned.
Do not imply reliable real-time support without benchmarked environments.
operational_notes: Inference latency and model size materially affect operator experience.
Validation should run known images or video clips with expected detections.
GPU claims should stay explicit and narrow.
risks: Vision-model wrappers drift quickly when not tied to active workflows.
Portable inference does not imply portable performance.
